headline: Quantum Control, Metrology, and Molecular Dynamics
summary: Today's research features diverse advancements in quantum mechanics, ranging from time-optimal generator bounds and secret-shared teleportation to topological superconducting circuits and molecular chiral tunneling. Additional contributions explore spectral gap labels for the unitary almost Mathieu operator and tensor train methods for multi-asset financial pricing.

themes.title: Quantum Dynamics, Information, and Metrology
themes.body: Explores time-optimal pure state conversion using fixed-norm generators, secret-shared teleportation of two-qudit entangling gates with deferred recipients, and enhanced sensing precision through weighted hypergraph states.

themes.title: Quantum Circuits and Spectral Theory
themes.body: Examines topologically protected edge states in inductively shunted flux qubits, alongside a rigorous determination of open spectral gap labels for the unitary almost Mathieu operator.

themes.title: Molecular Physics and Financial Mathematics
themes.body: Highlights the interplay of tunneling and transition polarizability across chiral torsional double wells, and introduces functional tensor trains for solving high-order Greeks in multi-asset structured products.
